description:
Based on the erotic doujin game by Dieselmine (ディーゼルマイン).

While working at a bar, the protagonist was asked to draw water.
Upon picking up a mysterious stone he found there, he was whelmed by light.
When he woke up, he finds himself in a country of succubi......!
Various types of lewd demons draw near to him. He has to store a certain amount of magic energy in order to get back to his original world!
What he will eventually face would be escape, or destiny to be a sperm slave forever...

(Source: DLsite English)
